Official Google `troubleshooting` skill for **Chrome DevTools MCP setup only** (formerly repo-prefixed `chrome-devtools-troubleshooting`). Use when MCP initialization, connection, page listing, navigation, missing tools, or Chrome profile selection fails.

## Name disambiguation

This skill is **`troubleshooting` from `ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp`**—MCP server setup and harness wiring only. It is **not** [`golang-troubleshooting`](./golang-troubleshooting) from `samber/cc-skills-golang` or other generic troubleshooting skills in this catalog.

## Audit evidence

- **Source:** [ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp)
- **Pinned commit:** `a90378adf3226e8b27a05cdcfdd801c199acaa93`
- **License:** Apache-2.0
- **Author:** Google LLC
- **Package:** `chrome-devtools-mcp` 0.23.0 (per `planning/manifests/external-skills/chrome-devtools-mcp.json`)
- **Source-list evidence:** `npx skills add github:ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp --list` lists upstream skill `troubleshooting`

## Dedupe

This curated install **replaces repo-vendored** `skills/chrome-devtools-troubleshooting/` copies. Upstream publishes the skill as `troubleshooting`; install the six-skill bundle once globally and drop prefixed repo trees after migration.

## Hooks, scripts, and credentials

Audited upstream skills at the pinned commit are guidance-only Markdown. **No hooks, bundled scripts, or credential requests** were identified in the skill bundle.

## Network access

Setup diagnostics may reference `npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --help` and local MCP endpoints. Application debugging after MCP is healthy belongs in `chrome-devtools` or the specialized skills in this bundle.

## Artifact hygiene

Do not commit local MCP config snapshots or diagnostic logs into the repository. Keep any exported diagnostics outside version control.
